source: Hoek, E., Carter, T.G. & Diederichs, M.S. (2013). Quantification of the Geological Strength Index chart. 47th US Rock Mechanics / Geomechanics Symposium, ARMA 13-672. Eqs. 1-6, Figure 5 and Tables 1-3 (Appendix 1). PDF: Referencias/Bibliografia/General/2013-Quantification-of-the-GSI-Chart.pdf (rocscience.com).

equations.jcond76: JCond89 = 1.3 JCond76; GSI = 2 JCond76 + RQD/2 (eq. 2, as published)
equations.jr_ja: JCond89 = 35 (Jr/Ja)/(1 + Jr/Ja); GSI = 52 (Jr/Ja)/(1 + Jr/Ja) + RQD/2 (eq. 3, as published)
equations.rqd_lambda: RQD = 100 e^(-0.1 lambda) (0.1 lambda + 1), lambda = discontinuities per metre (eq. 4, Priest & Hudson 1976; the minus sign is lost in the PDF rendering)
equations.rqd_jv: RQD = 115 - 3.3 Jv (eq. 5, Palmstrom 1982) or RQD = 110 - 2.5 Jv (eq. 6, Palmstrom 2005)

rsdata_note: RSData 1.009 GSI Calculator differs on the alternatives: JCond76 via 1.5 x 1.3 = 1.95 (not the published 2) and Jr/Ja via GSI = 5.5 ln(Jr/Ja) + 21 + RQD/2, a form not in this paper (Referencias/Ejemplos/RSData_analisis/08_estimacion_sin_ensayos.md). OGR follows the paper.

chart.y: RQD/2, from 0 to 40 (upper and lower rows of the 2000 chart removed, items 3-4 of the paper)
chart.rows_note: Structure bands read from Figure 5 (approximate positions on the RQD/2 axis).

rows.label: BLOCKY
rows.description: Well interlocked undisturbed rock mass made up of cubical blocks formed by three sets of intersecting joints

rows.label: VERY BLOCKY
rows.description: Interlocked, partially disturbed rock mass, multi-faceted angular blocks formed by 4 or more joint sets

rows.label: BLOCKY/DISTURBED/SEAMY
rows.description: Folded with angular blocks formed by many intersecting joint sets. Persistence of bedding planes or schistosity

rows.label: DISINTEGRATED
rows.description: Poorly interlocked, heavily broken rock mass with mixture of angular and rounded rock pieces

chart.columns_note: Surface condition headings of Figure 5, placed at the 1.5 JCond89 value of the matching condition rating of Table 1 (30, 25, 20, 10, 0).

columns.label: FAIR
columns.description: Smooth, moderately weathered and altered surfaces

columns.label: POOR
columns.description: Slickensided, highly weathered surfaces with compact coatings or fillings of angular fragments

columns.label: VERY POOR
columns.description: Slickensided, highly weathered surfaces with soft clay coatings or infillings

jcond89_conditions.description: Very rough surfaces, not continuous, no separation, unweathered wall rock
Slightly rough surfaces, separation < 1 mm, slightly weathered walls
Slightly rough surfaces, separation < 1 mm, highly weathered walls
Slickensided surfaces or gouge < 5 mm thick or separation 1-5 mm, continuous
Soft gouge > 5 mm thick or separation > 5 mm, continuous

jcond76_conditions.description: Very rough surfaces, not continuous, no separation, hard joint wall rock
Slightly rough surfaces, separation < 1 mm, hard joint wall rock
Slightly rough surfaces, separation < 1 mm, soft joint wall rock
Slickensided surfaces or gouge < 5 mm thick or joints open 1-5 mm, continuous joints
Soft gouge > 5 mm thick or joints open > 5 mm, continuous joints

ja: Tightly healed, hard, non-softening, impermeable filling
Unaltered joint walls, surface staining only
Slightly altered joint walls, non-softening mineral coatings, sandy particles, clay-free disintegrated rock, etc
Silty-, or sandy-clay coatings, small clay fraction (non-softening)

Softening or low friction clay, mineral coatings, i.e. kaolinite, mica. Also chlorite, talc, gypsum and graphite etc., and small quantities of swelling clays (discontinuous coatings, 1 - 2 mm or less in thickness)
